selected_records.definition: A partial-correctness contract: starting in a state satisfying P, every terminating execution of C ends in a state satisfying Q.
verificationObligation: Partial correctness does not imply termination. State the command relation and treatment of faults.
Use the stated carriers, equality, domain restrictions and semantic conventions; alternative conventions require an explicit variant.
selected_records.axiomBasis: Selected presentation: A partial-correctness contract: starting in a state satisfying P, every terminating execution of C ends in a state satisfying Q. Governing rules: A Hoare triple constrains every normally terminating behavior; it does not require termination. Sequential command semantics joins the intermediate state.
